title: Share one Obsidian vault as memory for 8 agents
summary: The author uses one Obsidian notes vault as shared memory for eight AI agents, including Claude Code and Codex, with a nightly agent fixing outdated facts.
agent_role: Agents read from and write to a shared notes vault. A scheduled agent fixes old facts and links unconnected notes every night.
outcome: Author says the project is free and has over 4,700 stars; no other results are stated.
what_they_did: The poster connected eight AI agents, including Claude Code, Codex and a Grok bot, to one Obsidian notes folder. The folder serves as their shared memory. Every night another agent fixes outdated facts and links notes that stand alone. A full guide is in a linked article.
prompt: Use my Obsidian vault at [vault path] as long-term memory. Every night, review notes changed in the last [N] days. Find facts that contradict newer notes and notes with no links. Propose fixes and new links as a list, and wait for my approval before you edit or delete anything.

curation.rationale: A genuine multi-agent setup with a nightly maintenance agent, but the post itself is thin and the details sit in a linked article not provided here.
